status: PRE-REGISTERED BLIND PREDICTIONS. No physical test has been performed; no measured data is included or implied.

engine.fixture_note: predictions frozen from the v0.3 engine; if the engine changes, re-issue this pre-registration and update the hash

material.name: rPETG (recycled PETG, printed parts)
provenance: research/01 R07 (printed rPETG, ISO 527-2: E 2.28 GPa CV 10.8%, peak stress 46.5 MPa; strain at peak 3.15-3.51%)

coupon_3x2.description: 3 x 2 cell X-braced lattice coupon cut from the same 20 mm cell family, uniform 2.0 mm struts, 10 mm solid clamp pad

geometry.topology: X-braced, both diagonals per cell, rigid nodes

uncertainty.model_form_note: coupon is the reference 7x3 family scaled to 3x2 cells; cell-size band (J1) does not transfer blindly

bracket_7x3_robust.description: shipped v0.3 robust design, frozen width-field controls

predicted.brittle_note: marginal brittle screen; joint 3-property probability not claimed (E-elongation correlation assumed -0.25)

model_form_band.source: independent J2 pin-jointed truss vs rigid frame (validation suite)

acceptance_band.rationale: first campaign: material 90% PI (~±16%) plus joint/model-form band (frame may over-predict strength demand by up to 14%)

specimen_count.coupon_3x2: n=5 per build orientation x 3 lots

test_protocol.fixture: cantilever: clamp the 10 mm pad face; distribute load over the tip nodes; measure tip deflection with an LVDT and load with a calibrated load cell
test_protocol.loading: quasi-static, 1 mm/min, load to the 150 N design load then to first yield (load-deflection slope break); do not exceed the fixture range
test_protocol.calibration: load cell calibrated per ISO 7500-1 class 1 or better; fixture compliance measured and subtracted
test_protocol.reporting: record build orientation and process parameters (ISO/ASTM 52921, ASTM F2971), lot ID, supplier, measured proxy values and measurement CV
test_protocol.elongation: extrusion-printed tensile coupons per ISO 527-2 (n=5 per lot) to measure elongation at break and test the brittle-lot screen; record strain at peak
test_protocol.blindness: predictions and acceptance criteria are frozen (this file's hash) before testing; no post-hoc model tuning before the comparison report is written
test_protocol.standards_note: protocol is informed by ASTM D790-style flexural practice, ISO 291 conditioning, ISO 7500-1 calibration and ISO/ASTM 52921 / ASTM F2971 reporting; it is not a certified test method for this bespoke lattice geometry

acceptance_criteria.stiffness: measured tip stiffness within [-25%, +25%] of the frozen predicted value for >= 4/5 specimens per lot; mean within [-15%, +15%]
acceptance_criteria.first_yield: measured first-yield load within [-25%, +35%] of the frozen predicted value for >= 4/5 specimens per lot
acceptance_criteria.coverage: the 90% material prediction interval should contain >= 80% of specimen values across lots; failure to cover widens the feedstock prior, it does not justify a point prediction
acceptance_criteria.brittle: measured elongation at break within the printed-elongation prior band (4.0% x[0.86,1.16] for rPETG); if the lot is brittle, the marginal brittle P_f must be reported as an add-on, never silently folded into the headline P_f
acceptance_criteria.trend: rank order of the two specimen families (coupon vs bracket) must be preserved
acceptance_criteria.failure_action: a criterion failure is reported as a validation finding with the discrepancy, not absorbed into a fudge factor; model discrepancy is calibrated explicitly

decision_and_updating.procedure: pre-registered blind comparison -> disconfirmation review -> Bayesian model updating with an explicit discrepancy term -> re-issued prediction package
decision_and_updating.claim_effect: passing this campaign would support L4 (component validation) for this geometry, process and material class only; it would not certify the product
decision_and_updating.data_handling: measured CSV is ingested with validation/compare_measurements.py and appended to the comparison record; the pre-registration hash is never edited
